generic: Something went wrong while creating your randomized game. Try another seed; the details are under Advanced.
genericWorld: The fog randomizer stopped with an unexpected problem. Your game was not changed. Try again; if it keeps happening, switch off the fog randomizer. The details are under Advanced.
unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again; the details are under Advanced.

codes.WORKSPACE_UNSAFE: The app could not find a safe place to work. Restart the app and try again.
codes.GAME_INVALID: This folder does not look like a complete Dark Souls Remastered installation. Verify the game files in Steam, or choose the game folder again.
codes.PRISTINE_IMPORT_REQUIRED: Dark Souls Remastered has not been checked yet. Wait a moment and try again.
codes.PRISTINE_SOURCE_UNSAFE: Your game files could not be verified. Verify the game files in Steam, then try again.
codes.PRISTINE_SOURCE_INVALID: Your game files could not be verified. Verify the game files in Steam, then try again.
codes.COMBINED_OUTPUT_MISMATCH: The randomized files failed a safety check, so nothing was changed. Try again, or use a different seed.
codes.COMBINED_OUTPUT_INVALID: The randomized files failed a safety check, so nothing was changed. Try again, or use a different seed.
codes.FOG_OUTPUT_MISMATCH: The randomized world files failed a safety check, so nothing was changed. Try again, or use a different seed.
codes.FOG_OUTPUT_INVALID: The randomized world files failed a safety check, so nothing was changed. Try again, or use a different seed.
codes.FOG_BRIDGE_INPUT_INVALID: The fog randomizer could not be set up with these settings. Try again, or change the fog settings.
codes.FOG_STAGING_FAILED: The fog randomizer could not be set up. Check that the disk has free space and try again.
codes.FOG_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED: The fog randomizer could not find a working layout for this seed and these settings. Try another seed, or switch off some fog options.
codes.FOG_SEED_UNSOLVABLE: The fog randomizer could not find a working layout for this seed and these settings. Try another seed, or switch off some fog options.
codes.FOG_UPSTREAM_INCOMPATIBLE: These item and fog settings cannot be combined yet. Your game was not changed. Switch off the fog randomizer or some extra item categories (NPC gifts, enemy drops, shops) and try again.
codes.FOG_ITEM_RULES_UNREADABLE: The fog randomizer data could not be read. Click Generate world again; if it keeps failing, restart the app.
codes.KEY_PLACEMENT_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: Key placement needs the world data of the fog randomizer, which could not be prepared. Click Generate world again, or turn Key placement off.
codes.RACE_LOCATION_INVALID: The Race Mode placement did not pass its final check, so nothing was written. Try another seed, or choose another key placement; the details are under Advanced.
codes.RACE_PLUS_LOCATION_INVALID: The Race Mode + placement did not pass its final check, so nothing was written. Try another seed, or choose another key placement; the details are under Advanced.
codes.DIFFICULTY_POLICY_UNSATISFIED: The items could not be arranged for the selected difficulty. Try another seed, or choose Fair.
codes.KEY_PLACEMENT_UNSATISFIABLE: No safe place was found for every key with these settings. Try another seed, or turn Key placement off.
codes.KEY_PLACEMENT_FILL_IMPOSSIBLE: The items could not be arranged around the keys with these settings. Try another seed, or turn Key placement off.
codes.KEY_PLACEMENT_INVALID: The key placement did not pass its final safety check, so nothing was written. Try another seed, or turn Key placement off; the details are under Advanced.
codes.KEY_PLACEMENT_MODEL_INVALID: The world data used for key placement is not usable. Restart the app and try again; the details are under Advanced.
codes.KEY_PLACEMENT_MODEL_MISSING: Key placement needs the world data of the fog randomizer, which was not available. Try again, or turn Key placement off.
codes.KEY_PLACEMENT_NOTHING_TO_PLACE: Key placement found no key it can move with these settings. Turn Key placement off.
codes.FOG_KEY_CONFLICT: The fog randomizer could not find a working layout around the shuffled keys for this seed. Try another seed, or turn Key placement or some fog options off.
codes.COMBINED_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED: No working combination was found for this seed. Try another seed.
codes.GENERATION_PROFILE_MISMATCH: This copy of the app cannot reproduce that world exactly, so nothing was generated. Update or reinstall DS1 Triple Randomizer.
codes.MANIFEST_WRITE_FAILED: Your randomized files could not be saved. Check that the disk has free space and try again.
codes.ENEMY_PLACEMENT_CUSTOM_POOL_INVALID: The custom enemy pool cannot be used with these settings. Change the pool or the placement options; the details are under Advanced.
codes.ENEMY_PLACEMENT_INFEASIBLE: The enemy placement settings leave no valid layout for this seed. Try another seed, or loosen the placement options; the details are under Advanced.
codes.FOG_PREREQUISITES_MISSING: The fog randomizer data is not ready yet. Wait until it has been prepared, or click Retry.
codes.PIPELINE_FAILED: Something went wrong while creating your randomized game. Try another seed; the details are under Advanced.
codes.WORLD_DATA_GAME_VERSION: This version of Dark Souls Remastered is not supported by the fog randomizer yet. Verify the game files in Steam, or turn the fog randomizer off.
codes.WORLD_DATA_GAME_FILES: Your Dark Souls Remastered files could not be read. Verify the game files in Steam and try again.
codes.WORLD_DATA_OFFLINE: The fog randomizer files could not be prepared. Check your internet connection and click Retry.
codes.WORLD_DATA_DOWNLOAD_CORRUPT: The fog randomizer data could not be verified. Click Retry; if it keeps failing, check your internet connection.
codes.WORLD_DATA_WRITE_FAILED: The fog randomizer data could not be saved. Check that the disk has free space and try again.
codes.STATE_ROOT_UNSAFE: The app's data folder and the game folder must be separate.
codes.STATE_LOCKED: Another apply, restore or check of this game is already running.
codes.SNAPSHOT_EXISTS: The original game files were already saved for this installation.
codes.GAME_STATE_UNKNOWN: The game has changes this app did not make. Restore the original game files, or verify the game files in Steam.
codes.LEGACY_ARTIFACTS_DETECTED: The installation contains backup or temporary files left by other randomizers; it is probably not clean. Verify the game files in Steam first.
codes.NOT_VANILLA: This installation does not match the known original Dark Souls Remastered files. Verify the game files in Steam first.
codes.PRISTINE_IMPORT_FAILED: The original game files could not be saved. Check that the disk has free space and try again.
codes.PACKAGE_INVALID: The generated files are not usable. Create the world again.
codes.PACKAGE_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH: These generated files were not made from this installation. Create the world again.
codes.PACKAGE_TAMPERED: The generated files failed verification, so nothing was changed. Create the world again.
codes.PACKAGE_EMPTY: The generated files change nothing in the game. Create the world again.
codes.GAME_RUNNING: Close Dark Souls Remastered, then try again.
codes.GAME_STATE_NOT_VANILLA: The game is not original right now. Restore the original game first.
codes.PRISTINE_COPY_DAMAGED: The saved original game files are damaged, so nothing was changed. Verify the game files in Steam.
codes.ACTIVATION_FAILED: The randomized game could not be applied and the original files were put back.
codes.ACTIVATION_INTERRUPTED: Applying was interrupted before it could be undone. Click Restore original game to repair it.
codes.SNAPSHOT_STALE: The game was updated since its original files were saved, so restoring could break it. Verify the game files in Steam.
codes.RESTORE_INCOMPLETE: Some game files could not be restored. Click Restore original game again.
codes.CHECKSUM: This seed code is invalid or damaged. Copy it again from the person who shared it.
codes.MALFORMED: This is not a valid seed code. Copy it again from the person who shared it.
codes.UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: This seed code was made by a newer version of DS1 Triple Randomizer. Update the app to use it.
codes.UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE: This seed needs a newer version of DS1 Triple Randomizer. Update the app to generate this world.
codes.INVALID_SETTINGS: The settings inside this seed code cannot be used by this version of the app.
codes.BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE: DS1 Triple Randomizer could not reach its engine. Close and reopen the app.
codes.BUNDLE_SANITIZATION_FAILED: The support bundle was not made: the application could not make sure that no personal data was left in it. Nothing was saved.
codes.BUNDLE_TOO_LARGE: The support bundle would be too large, so it was not made.
codes.BUNDLE_INVALID_ENTRY: The support bundle was not made because of an internal problem. Nothing was saved.
codes.BUNDLE_EMPTY: There is nothing to put into a support bundle yet.
codes.HINTS_UNAVAILABLE: The hint sheet is not available for this world.
codes.DATA_TOOL_MISSING: The game data tool of the app could not be started. Reinstall DS1 Triple Randomizer; the details are under Advanced.
codes.DATA_TOOL_FAILED: The game data could not be processed. Try again; if it keeps happening, verify the game files in Steam. The details are under Advanced.
codes.CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE: The game data could not be prepared. Click Generate world again; if it keeps failing, restart the app.
codes.CATALOG_UNREADABLE: The game data could not be read. Click Generate world again; if it keeps failing, restart the app.
codes.CATALOG_STALE: The prepared game data is out of date. Restart the app and try again.
codes.CATALOG_SOURCE_MISMATCH: The prepared game data does not belong to this installation. Restart the app and try again; if the game was updated, verify its files in Steam.
codes.OUTPUT_WRITE_FAILED: Your randomized files could not be saved. Check that the disk has free space and try again.
codes.NO_RANDOMIZATION_FEATURES_ENABLED: Nothing is switched on to randomize. Turn on items, enemies or bosses, or the fog randomizer.
codes.WORKSPACE_INSIDE_GAME_DIRECTORY: The app could not find a safe place to work. Restart the app and try again.
codes.INVALID_CONFIG: These settings cannot be used. Change them and try again.
codes.FOG_HOST_MISSING: The fog randomizer component is missing. Reinstall DS1 Triple Randomizer, or switch off the fog randomizer.
codes.FOG_HOST_CRASHED: The fog randomizer stopped unexpectedly. Your game was not changed. Try again; if it keeps happening, switch off the fog randomizer.
codes.FOG_HOST_TIMEOUT: The fog randomizer took too long and was stopped. Your game was not changed. Try again, or try another seed.
codes.FOG_MERGE_CONFLICT: The fog randomizer and the other randomization could not be combined for this seed. Your game was not changed. Try another seed.
codes.FOG_DATA_MISSING: The fog randomizer data is not ready yet. Wait until it has been prepared, or click Retry.

problems.notJson: The text is not a valid preset (it is not readable JSON).
problems.notObject: The text is not a valid preset (a preset is one JSON object).
problems.format: This is not a DS1 Triple Randomizer preset.
problems.version: This preset has a version this app does not read. Use a preset exported by this app (preset version {{version}}), or an older one.
problems.unsupportedOption: The preset contains an option this version does not know: {{option}}.
problems.missingOption: The preset is missing the option {{option}}.
problems.wrongType: The option {{option}} has a value of the wrong kind.
problems.masterSeedRequired: The preset has no master seed.
problems.invalidChoice: A setting has a value this version does not know.
problems.racePlusFair: Race Mode + is only available with Fair item difficulty.
problems.keysNeedWorldItems: Key placement needs Items and World items to be on.
problems.keysProtected: Key placement and protected-item randomization cannot be combined.
problems.lordNeedsKeys: The Lordvessel and Lord Souls switches need Key placement other than Vanilla.
problems.protectedBlocked: Protected-item randomization is not available yet.
problems.dlcWithFog: DLC content can only be left out when the fog randomizer is off: the fog randomizer always includes the DLC areas.
problems.randomStart: A random start needs boss fogs or traversable fogs to be on.
problems.nothingEnabled: Turn on at least one of items, enemies, bosses or the fog randomizer.
